t: A conditional you can act on today
a: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تَنصُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرْكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَكُمْ
p: Yā ayyuha-lladhīna āmanū in tanṣuru-llāha yanṣurkum wa yuthabbit aqdāmakum.
m: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
